name: Mail Client
description: Multi-provider email client — Google, Microsoft, Yahoo, IMAP. Inbox, send, reply, forward, search, archive, manage emails, contacts.

tools.name: skeleton_refresh_mail_inbox_summary
tools.description: Per-account unread summary for classifier envelope + new-mail alerts.

tools.name: skeleton_alert_mail_inbox_summary
tools.description: Alert check for new unread emails.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Start Google/Gmail OAuth — returns an authorisation URL to open in the browser. If an account is already connected, returns it without regenerating a URL.

params_schema.description: No parameters required — satisfies V17 for parameterless @chat.function handlers.
params_schema.title: EmptyParams

return_schema.description: OAuth authorisation result — returned by connect/connect_microsoft/connect_yahoo.
return_schema.title: OAuthConnectResult

tools.name: connect_microsoft
tools.description: Start Microsoft Outlook / Office 365 OAuth — returns an authorisation URL. For on-premise Exchange or non-OAuth Microsoft accounts use connect_imap instead.

params_schema.description: No parameters required — satisfies V17 for parameterless @chat.function handlers.
params_schema.title: EmptyParams

return_schema.description: OAuth authorisation result — returned by connect/connect_microsoft/connect_yahoo.
return_schema.title: OAuthConnectResult

tools.name: connect_yahoo
tools.description: Start Yahoo or AOL OAuth — returns an authorisation URL. For direct IMAP access to Yahoo/AOL use connect_imap instead.

params_schema.description: No parameters required — satisfies V17 for parameterless @chat.function handlers.
params_schema.title: EmptyParams

return_schema.description: OAuth authorisation result — returned by connect/connect_microsoft/connect_yahoo.
return_schema.title: OAuthConnectResult

tools.name: connect_imap
tools.description: Connect an email account via IMAP/SMTP credentials — iCloud, Zoho, Yandex, Mail.ru, webhostmost, any custom domain. Auto-detects server settings; tests connection before saving. Use this when OAuth is unavailable.

return_schema.description: IMAP/SMTP connection result — returned by connect_imap/add_imap.
return_schema.title: ImapConnectResult

tools.name: status
tools.description: List all connected email accounts — shows provider (Google/Microsoft/Yahoo/IMAP), which account is active, and current unread count for each.

params_schema.description: No parameters required — satisfies V17 for parameterless @chat.function handlers.
params_schema.title: EmptyParams

MailAccountEntity.description: Connected email account — item in AccountsPage.
MailAccountEntity.title: MailAccountEntity

return_schema.description: All connected accounts — returned by status().
return_schema.title: AccountsPage

tools.name: switch_account
tools.description: Change the active email account. All subsequent inbox, send, and manage operations will use this account until switched again.

account.title: Account

return_schema.description: Active account change confirmation — returned by switch_account().
return_schema.title: AccountSwitchedResult

tools.name: disconnect
tools.description: Remove a connected email account and permanently delete its stored credentials and access tokens.

account.description: Account email or ID (omit for active account)
account.title: Account

return_schema.description: Account removal confirmation — returned by disconnect().
return_schema.title: AccountDisconnectedResult

tools.name: inbox
tools.description: PRIMARY function to list emails. Use this when user asks for recent/latest/new emails, wants to see their inbox, or check mail. Use folder= for non-inbox folders (sent/spam/trash/drafts/starred/archive). Returns message previews with IDs, subjects, senders, dates, read state. Do NOT use search() for listing recent emails — use inbox().

EmailPreview.description: Email preview row — item in inbox/folder/search list results.
EmailPreview.title: EmailPreview

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

return_schema.description: Paginated inbox/folder result — returned by inbox() and folder().
return_schema.title: InboxPage

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Open and read the full content of an email by message_id. Returns body (HTML + plain text), sender, all recipients, date, attachments. Also marks it as read. ALWAYS call this after inbox() or search() before replying, forwarding, archiving, or doing anything that requires knowing what the email says.

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

return_schema.description: Full email message — returned by read_email().
return_schema.title: EmailMessage

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find specific emails by content, sender, or subject. Use free-text or provider syntax (Gmail: from:sender, subject:topic, label:name; Outlook/IMAP: free-text). Only use when searching for something specific. For listing recent/latest emails use inbox() instead.

EmailPreview.description: Email preview row — item in inbox/folder/search list results.
EmailPreview.title: EmailPreview

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

return_schema.description: Email search results — returned by search().
return_schema.title: SearchPage

tools.name: folder
tools.description: Fetch a page from a specific non-INBOX folder (sent, drafts, spam, trash, starred, archive). Functionally identical to inbox() with folder= — prefer inbox() unless explicit folder routing is needed.

EmailPreview.description: Email preview row — item in inbox/folder/search list results.
EmailPreview.title: EmailPreview

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

return_schema.description: Paginated inbox/folder result — returned by inbox() and folder().
return_schema.title: InboxPage

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Load a complete email conversation by thread_id — all messages in chronological order. Works on Google and Microsoft; IMAP returns a single-message fallback.

EmailPreview.description: Email preview row — item in inbox/folder/search list results.
EmailPreview.title: EmailPreview

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

return_schema.description: Full email conversation — returned by get_thread().
return_schema.title: EmailThread

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send a brand-new email. Requires to and body; subject is auto-generated from the first line of body if omitted. Use reply() or forward() when responding to an existing message.

subject.description: Email subject (auto-generated from body if omitted)
subject.title: Subject

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

return_schema.description: Sent/replied/forwarded confirmation — returned by send/reply/forward.
return_schema.title: SentEmailResult

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Reply to an email. REQUIRED chain: 1) inbox() or search() to find the email and get message_id, 2) read_email(message_id) to read its content, 3) reply(message_id, body=<your response>). NEVER skip read_email() — you must know what you are replying to. Only omit message_id if read_email() was already called in this same session. Use send() for new emails, not replies.

message_id.description: Message ID to reply to (omit = last read)
message_id.title: Message Id

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

return_schema.description: Sent/replied/forwarded confirmation — returned by send/reply/forward.
return_schema.title: SentEmailResult

tools.name: forward
tools.description: Forward an existing email to a new address. REQUIRED chain: 1) inbox() or search() to find the email and get message_id, 2) read_email(message_id) to load its content, 3) forward(message_id, to=<address>). NEVER skip read_email() — the original body must be loaded before forwarding. Requires message_id and to address.

comment.description: Optional comment prepended to the forwarded body
comment.title: Comment

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

return_schema.description: Sent/replied/forwarded confirmation — returned by send/reply/forward.
return_schema.title: SentEmailResult

tools.name: archive
tools.description: Archive a single email — removes it from INBOX, stays searchable and recoverable. Requires message_id: call inbox() or search() first if you don't have it yet. Not the same as delete().

return_schema.description: Single-message operation confirmation — archive/delete/mark/star/move/purge.
return_schema.title: MailOpResult

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Move a single email to Trash — recoverable until emptied. Requires message_id: call inbox() or search() first if you don't have it yet. Use purge() for permanent deletion.

return_schema.description: Single-message operation confirmation — archive/delete/mark/star/move/purge.
return_schema.title: MailOpResult

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: Mark a single email as read (clears the unread indicator). For multiple emails use bulk_mark_read().

return_schema.description: Single-message operation confirmation — archive/delete/mark/star/move/purge.
return_schema.title: MailOpResult

tools.name: mark_unread
tools.description: Mark a single email as unread (restores the unread indicator). For multiple emails use bulk_mark_unread().

return_schema.description: Single-message operation confirmation — archive/delete/mark/star/move/purge.
return_schema.title: MailOpResult

tools.name: star
tools.description: Add or remove the starred/important flag on an email. Pass starred=true to star, starred=false to unstar — explicit, not a toggle. Requires message_id: call inbox() or search() first if you don't have it yet.

starred.description: True to star, False to unstar
starred.title: Starred

return_schema.description: Single-message operation confirmation — archive/delete/mark/star/move/purge.
return_schema.title: MailOpResult

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move an email from one folder to another — e.g. INBOX→spam, Trash→INBOX (untrash). Requires both from_folder and to_folder.

return_schema.description: Single-message operation confirmation — archive/delete/mark/star/move/purge.
return_schema.title: MailOpResult

tools.name: purge
tools.description: Permanently delete an email — cannot be recovered. Requires message_id: call inbox() or search() first if you don't have it. Use delete() to move to Trash first if unsure.

return_schema.description: Single-message operation confirmation — archive/delete/mark/star/move/purge.
return_schema.title: MailOpResult

tools.name: bulk_archive
tools.description: Archive multiple emails in one operation. Pass message_ids as a comma-separated string.

return_schema.description: Bulk email operation summary — bulk_archive/delete/mark_read/mark_unread.
return_schema.title: BulkMailOpResult

tools.name: bulk_delete
tools.description: Move multiple emails to Trash in one operation. Pass message_ids as a comma-separated string.

return_schema.description: Bulk email operation summary — bulk_archive/delete/mark_read/mark_unread.
return_schema.title: BulkMailOpResult

tools.name: bulk_mark_read
tools.description: Mark multiple emails as read in one operation. Pass message_ids as a comma-separated string.

return_schema.description: Bulk email operation summary — bulk_archive/delete/mark_read/mark_unread.
return_schema.title: BulkMailOpResult

tools.name: bulk_mark_unread
tools.description: Mark multiple emails as unread in one operation. Pass message_ids as a comma-separated string.

return_schema.description: Bulk email operation summary — bulk_archive/delete/mark_read/mark_unread.
return_schema.title: BulkMailOpResult
